title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: CDR > EAC > WavMerge > CD-Wave > Soundforge > TLH > FLAC.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience field recording that captures a high‑energy show with standout Bertha, the debut of Touch of Grey and a smoking Phil chant into The Other One.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers an immersive, three‑dimensional soundscape that lets listeners feel like they’re in the crowd, while the performance is charged with good spirits and strong playing. Highlights include the first‑time hearing of “Touch of Grey,” a rousing Phil chant leading into a monster “Other One,” and tight renditions of Bertha and U.S. Blues. Recording quality is superb for an audience source, making it a must‑have for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are 4–5 stars and praise both the musical energy and the surprisingly high fidelity of this field recording, resulting in a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note an uncanny 3‑D space, crisp clarity, and great headphone experience; no major dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth flow from the upbeat first set into a high‑spirited second set, with the crowd feeding off the band's good mood and venue vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocal tone is noted as slightly less sweet than usual, though he gives his all.
band_member_comments.Phil: Fans rave about a massive Phil chant and "major bombs" from his bass during the jam.
